title: Findings G-B2, G-M3, G-M5 and minor items of review 3 (slow checks through `check NAME`)
tail: Read symbols with `python3 -m scripts.article index slice NAME` instead of whole files. For the named checks theses-lint, index-check, claims-quote-check, make-validate and lint-counts, run `python3 -m scripts.article check NAME` (with the tool wrapper prefix) instead of the matching command by hand; it reuses a stored result when nothing the check reads has changed. Other commands run as before.
